faqs.q: What is the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) and where is it used?
faqs.a: The Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) is a wire rope ferrule to EN 13411-3 / DIN 3093 that is pressed onto the rope tail to close an eye termination. It is listed in sizes 1 mm to 60 mm, each size under its own Indus part number.

faqs.q: How do I read Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) part numbers such as IH-LR-FS-AEN-1MM?
faqs.a: IH-LR-FS-AEN-1MM is the 1 mm size, IH-LR-FS-AEN-20MM the 20 mm size and IH-LR-FS-AEN-60MM the 60 mm size. The size table lists every Indus part number with its own dimensions and rating, so quote the full part number rather than the series name.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) come in?
faqs.a: Sizes on the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) run 1 mm to 60 mm. The size table gives each one its own Indus part number and dimensions, and the [wire rope ferrules & sleeves shelf](/c/wire-rope-ferrules-sleeves) lists the neighbouring products.

faqs.q: How should I pick the size of Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) for my job?
faqs.a: The Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) is selected by the rope diameter, shown as the size in the table (1 mm to 60 mm). Quote the Indus part number for the size you pick, and press it only with dies made for that rope and sleeve.

faqs.q: What is the rated capacity of the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093)?
faqs.a: No load rating is published on the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) listing, only dimensions, so we state none here. Send the load and application on the RFQ and we confirm a suitable rated option.

faqs.q: What is the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) made from and how is it finished?
faqs.a: The Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) is made from aluminium. Aluminium ferrules and sleeves are the usual choice for pressed eyes in galvanized rope; match the material to the rope and the pressing tool.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093)?
faqs.a: The Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) is listed as EN 13411-3 / DIN 3093, and the manufacturer's test certificate comes with each consignment. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Which parts connect to the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093)?
faqs.a: Pair the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) with [steel wire rope](/c/steel-wire-rope) of the matching size and a thimble from the [wire rope thimbles](/c/wire-rope-thimbles) where the eye needs one. The [wire rope clips](/c/wire-rope-clips) are the non-swaged alternative, and the [sockets and terminals](/c/wire-rope-sockets-terminals) cover end fittings.

faqs.q: How should the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) be fitted and inspected?
faqs.a: The Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) must be pressed with a swaging tool and dies that match the sleeve and rope size, and the result checked against the maker's figures. See [our guide to wire rope eye terminations](/blog/wire-rope-eye-terminations) for the layout of the eye.

faqs.q: How does the Aluminium Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093) compare with the Stainless Steel Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093)?
faqs.a: The nearest sibling is the [Stainless Steel Ferrule — EN 13411-3 (DIN 3093)](/p/stainless-steel-ferrule-en-13411-3-din-3093), and the two differ on pattern and material. In detail, pattern is EN 13411-3 / DIN 3093 here and EN 13411-3 there; material is aluminium here and stainless steel AISI304 / AISI316 there. Pick on the standard, material and finish your job calls for, then quote the part number from the size table.

faqs.a: IH-LR-FS-SSB-012 is the 1/8″ size, IH-LR-FS-SSB-056 the 9/16″ size and IH-LR-FS-SSB-125 the 1-1/4″ size. The size table lists every Indus part number with its own dimensions and rating, so quote the full part number rather than the series name.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Steel Stop Button come in?
faqs.a: Sizes on the Steel Stop Button run 1/8″ to 1-1/4″. The size table gives each one its own Indus part number and dimensions, and the [wire rope ferrules & sleeves shelf](/c/wire-rope-ferrules-sleeves) lists the neighbouring products.

faqs.q: How should I pick the size of Steel Stop Button for my job?
faqs.a: The Steel Stop Button is selected by the rope diameter, shown as the size in the table (1/8″ to 1-1/4″). Quote the Indus part number for the size you pick, and press it only with dies made for that rope and sleeve.

faqs.q: What is the rated capacity of the Steel Stop Button?
faqs.a: No load rating is published on the Steel Stop Button listing, only dimensions, so we state none here. Send the load and application on the RFQ and we confirm a suitable rated option.

faqs.q: What is the Steel Stop Button made from and how is it finished?
faqs.a: The Steel Stop Button is made from steel. Ask on the RFQ if your specification needs the material grade or coating confirmed before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to the Steel Stop Button?
faqs.a: The Steel Stop Button ships with the manufacturer's test certificate for each consignment. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What do I use with the Steel Stop Button?
faqs.a: Pair the Steel Stop Button with [steel wire rope](/c/steel-wire-rope) of the matching size and a thimble from the [wire rope thimbles](/c/wire-rope-thimbles) where the eye needs one. The [wire rope clips](/c/wire-rope-clips) are the non-swaged alternative, and the [sockets and terminals](/c/wire-rope-sockets-terminals) cover end fittings.

faqs.q: How should the Steel Stop Button be fitted and inspected?
faqs.a: The Steel Stop Button must be pressed with a swaging tool and dies that match the sleeve and rope size, and the result checked against the maker's figures. See [our guide to wire rope eye terminations](/blog/wire-rope-eye-terminations) for the layout of the eye.

faqs.q: How does the Steel Stop Button compare with the Aluminium Stop Button?
faqs.a: The nearest sibling is the [Aluminium Stop Button](/p/aluminium-stop-button), and the two differ on material and size range. In detail, material is steel here and aluminium there; size range is 1/8″ to 1-1/4″ here and 3/64″ to 3/8″ there. Pick on the standard, material and finish your job calls for, then quote the part number from the size table.

faqs.q: Do you ship the Steel Stop Button outside the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes, Steel Stop Button goes out of Dubai, UAE to export customers worldwide. Tell us the destination port or country on [our contact page](/contact) and we quote the shipping route with the price.

faqs.q: Do you hold the Steel Stop Button for delivery from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, Steel Stop Button is held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
